searchText: The cat herders would like to help improve eips.ethereum.org. Sorry to bother <@!425279588009246720>, again, but he is the only person I know of that could give us access to that. I’ve sent him a Discord DM, and sent him e-mail but haven’t received a response. Does anyone else have any ideas of who I might contact, to help improve eips.ethereum.org? <@!396163506757435403> what are you interested in doing? the website template is all available in the EIPS repo and you are free to make any changes and put up PRs for those changes <@!301186049323958275> will review them within a few hours, and if somehow they slip through the cracks, i usually get to them after a week or two Basically, there currently isn’t one canonical source of EIP information. We’re trying to clean this up and make a single source of EIP info that is definitive, and easy to find. Some of the changes we’d like to make are quite significant. For example, @Mica wants to pull the EIP meta information out of EIP 1, and move it into a page on eips.ethererum.org. So, I’m thinking it would be a good idea to get more review, than just a few people, if only for a heads up about changes, like moving EIP-1, about to happen. Towards that end, I’m hoping there might be some kind of a staging version of eips.ethereum.org, on which we can put together a proposal, and make sure everyone is on board, with such significant changes, before doing a pull request for all that. If there isn’t a staging system, I might be able to set one up, myself. We’re putting together a proposal of what we want to do in this google doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1hUpMQh9gA5z3WSDvXKqU_CS6g3Y0hugJZHDYQdKxot8/edit?usp=sharing You can fork the EIPs GitHub repository, which is the source for eips.ethereum.org. You could also run a mirror of the website, though I don't personally know how to do that bit. Yea, that's what I'm thinking, if that doesn't exist, yet.

excerpts.author: brent.allsop
excerpts.content:
Basically, there currently isn’t one canonical source of EIP information.  We’re trying to clean this up and make a single source of EIP info that is definitive, and easy to find.
Some of the changes we’d like to make are quite significant.  For example, @Mica wants to pull the EIP meta information out of EIP 1, and move it into a page on eips.ethererum.org.
So, I’m thinking it would be a good idea to get more review, than just a few people, if only for a heads up about changes, like moving EIP-1, about to happen.
Towards that end, I’m hoping there might be some kind of a staging version of eips.ethereum.org, on which we can put together a proposal, and make sure everyone is on board, with such significant changes, before doing a pull request for all that.
If there isn’t a staging system, I might be able to set one up, myself.
We’re putting together a proposal of what we want to do in this google doc:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1hUpMQh9gA5z3WSDvXKqU_CS6g3Y0hugJZHDYQdKxot8/edit?usp=sharing
